reason: Make existing server-quoted InstaPay/manual-review checkout primary, retire new online enrollment after authentication/tenant admission, remove customer provider branding and prevent stale selected instructions after a failed quote. Keep historical payment evidence, callbacks, audit, existing paid-period conflicts and authorization unchanged. No recipient is inferred or configured.

title.en: Pay by InstaPay with manual review

summary.en: Choose a plan, review its payment instructions and submit a receipt for authorized review.
summary.ar: اختر باقة وراجع تعليمات الدفع ثم أرسل الإيصال للمراجعة المخوّلة.

details.en: A transfer or receipt submission does not activate access. Prices and instructions come from the server quote; missing instructions block payment preparation. Existing payment records are preserved.
details.ar: التحويل أو إرسال الإيصال لا يفعّل الاشتراك. تصدر الأسعار والتعليمات من عرض السعر بالنظام، ويتعذر إعداد الدفع عند غياب التعليمات. تظل سجلات الدفع السابقة محفوظة.
